text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp was drawing to a 
close. As for Wonder Acute—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Whooooo! I can still keep going, ya 
hear...! Not yettt!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —It's changed.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, what a savory smell. It's making my 
mouth water. But...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Think I'll pass. It always makes my body 
feel so heavy, after all...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —It's changed.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ohooooo! The real deal starts here, right 
here! Horyaaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —It's changed. Clearly.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her steadily plunging mood has clearly hit 
rock bottom and stopped. This too is...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Even if it was just that one time, we 
should still tell her properly. To 
Tarumae-chan, that is.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I need to make sure I don't run 
pathetically, at least.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The promise I made with Hokko Tarumae has 
truly given me a purpose in life. Yes—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Truly, it is only when Umamusume interact 
with other Umamusume that they can truly—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Still, Trainer-san, you're truly skilled, 
aren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Near the start of the camp, I was doing 
things pretty much at my own pace, right?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Her body had completely slacked off, yet 
she's already brought herself back this 
far.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps you have quite the knack for 
caregiving, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A strength I hadn't even noticed in 
myself. My training methods seem effective 
for Umamusume who have peaked.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I was able to realize that thanks to 
Wonder Acute. And also—"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, Trainer-san. Looks like we can go 
with this without feeling embarrassed.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...The 'JBC Classic.' A race to remember, 
running with Tarumae-chan just this once.
